measures.name: Area Record Share
measures.expression: DIVIDE([Total Delivery Records], CALCULATE([Total Delivery Records], ALLSELECTED(dim_area[area_name])))
measures.description: Records in the current area divided by records in all selected areas. Other filters are retained.

measures.name: Area Sample Signal
measures.expression:
VAR Records = [Total Delivery Records]
VAR LargestArea = MAXX(ALLSELECTED(dim_area[area_name]), [Total Delivery Records])
RETURN
    IF(Records > 0 && ISINSCOPE(dim_area[area_name]),
        SWITCH(TRUE(), Records < 200, "Small n", Records = LargestArea, "Largest group", "—")
    )
measures.description: Flags areas with fewer than 200 records, then identifies the largest selected area by volume.

measures.name: Area Sample Background
measures.description: Amber fill for a non-empty area with fewer than 200 records.

measures.name: Category Bar Color
measures.description: Grocery uses the Overview orange accent. Other categories use Overview blue.

measures.name: Valid distance
measures.expression: DIVIDE(COALESCE(CALCULATE([Total Delivery Records], KEEPFILTERS(fact_delivery[valid_distance_flag] = TRUE())), 0), [Total Delivery Records])
measures.description: Share of filtered records flagged as valid distance.

measures.name: Valid rating
measures.expression: DIVIDE(COALESCE(CALCULATE([Total Delivery Records], KEEPFILTERS(fact_delivery[valid_rating_flag] = TRUE())), 0), [Total Delivery Records])
measures.description: Share of filtered records flagged as valid agent rating.

measures.name: Pickup delay available
measures.expression: DIVIDE(COALESCE(CALCULATE([Total Delivery Records], KEEPFILTERS(NOT ISBLANK(fact_delivery[pickup_delay_minutes]))), 0), [Total Delivery Records])
measures.description: Share of filtered records with a nonblank pickup delay, including zero.

measures.name: Operational context complete
measures.expression: DIVIDE(COALESCE(CALCULATE([Total Delivery Records], KEEPFILTERS(fact_delivery[missing_operational_context_flag] = FALSE())), 0), [Total Delivery Records])
measures.description: Share of filtered records with order time, weather and traffic available.
